summary: Cel Sci Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of 2,500,000 common shares at $1.00 per share. ThinkEquity LLC serves as placement agent but has no obligation to purchase any shares; there is no minimum offering requirement and no escrow. The offering proceeds are available immediately upon sale. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. It is a standard at-the-market or follow-on offering under Rule 424(b)(5) with no strategic event, activist involvement, or structural change. The filing is a plain-vanilla equity issuance with no deal terms to track.
